final: SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS average_spent, AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining, AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS remaining_above_overall_mean FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, remaining_above_overall_mean DESC LIMIT 10
